name: Gilliana
description: Gilliana was a planet in the Tapani sector's Gilliana system in the Cadriaan Province. Settlers from Gilliana colonized Aleron.
lead_paragraphs: Gilliana was a planet in the Tapani sector's Gilliana system in the Cadriaan Province. Settlers from Gilliana colonized Aleron.
Lanthe Artifice was based on Gilliana.
